use default

digits_of(s: string) -> LIST[int] is
    let value = c => cast int(c) - cast int('0')

    s |> reverse() |> map(value) |> collect_list()
si

multiply(a: string, b: string) -> string is
    let da = digits_of(a)
    let db = digits_of(b)
    let result = (0::(da.count + db.count)) |> map(_ => 0) |> collect_list()

    for i in 0..da.count do
        for j in 0..db.count do
            result[i + j] = result[i + j] + da[i] * db[j]
        od
    od

    let carry mut = 0

    for k in 0..result.count do
        let total = result[k] + carry

        result[k] = total % 10
        carry = total / 10
    od

    let raw = result |> reverse() |> map(d => "{d}") |> join("")
    let trimmed = raw.trim_start(['0'])

    if trimmed.length == 0 then "0" else trimmed fi
si
